cases.name: Tanya C. Hall
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Tanya was a hard-working single mother. She worked hard to enjoy the finer things in life and loved to give all she could to others. She loved taking her son to the beach, ski mountains and had many more plans for great adventures. She experienced life with a smile and lit up every room she walked into. She encouraged and motivated all of those in need. She was loyal to a fault and everyone who met her was captivated by her vivacious personality. Her family and friends will be saying their goodbyes with the utmost regret and sorrow"
